answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The first ripple of coordinated fakery trips detection, keeping real judgment the scarce resource an attacker cannot simply buy. Picture a atlas field, a copper in flight, a relic in the distance — a natural triad mirroring how layered signals resist a single-point forgery.
